_comment: MNE-1064 — per-layer enforcement policy for verify-docs-gate.yml. Consumed by .github/scripts/enforce-docs-gate.sh against the run's SurfaceReport (report.json). 'blocking' layers fail the PR when (failed + errors) exceeds budget for that axis -- normally budget 0, so ANY new drift in a now-clean layer red-walls immediately. 'advisory' layers never fail the PR; their budget/reason fields are informational, tracking a known false-positive backlog pending a gate-infra fix (never a reason to edit docs to match a stale oracle).
verified_against_run: local verify-full.sh --env=prod --layers=cli,sdk,links against docs@b4b3182 + mnemom-test@0ba42e2 + mnemom-platform@0a74ead, 2026-07-21

api-coverage.reason: not in MNE-1064 scope; validates against the committed API spec (mnemom-test #61) -- candidate for a future flip ticket, not this one.

api-examples.reason: wraps the live-prod walker (curl bodies vs requestBody schemas against api.mnemom.ai) -- has a live-prod dependency, stays advisory per MNE-1064's explicit scope (cli/sdk/links only).

cli.reason: SUPERSEDES the earlier (2026-07-21) 'commands exist in the live CLI / do not edit the docs' note. MNE-2290's authoritative 2026-07-27 ROUTING+SCOPE decision established that `mnemom org use` (was gateway/cli.mdx:84) and `mnemom agents move` (was gateway/cli.mdx:366) are NOT part of the actual CLI surface (`org`: list, show; `agents`: claim), and the docs were correctly reconciled by removing both phantom commands in #408 (commit d103cb1). A repo-wide sweep (`grep -rn 'org use|agents move' --include=*.mdx --include=*.md`, excluding node_modules + the historical app_docs/feature-b176ba69 description) now returns no rendered-page hit, so this layer reports 0 CLI failures. RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP (not done here): once a live run confirms failed==0, flip this layer's mode to blocking with budget 0 so any future CLI drift red-walls immediately. Left advisory in this PR because the flip depends on mnemom-test-side oracle state not verifiable from this repo.

sdk.reason: Verified genuinely clean as of 2026-07-21: live run against mnemom-platform@main (shared/sdk/src) reports 5/5 pass, 0 fail, 0 warn, 0 err. No live-prod dependency. Flipped per MNE-1064.

links.reason: The nightly failures are backtick-quoted link-SYNTAX EXAMPLES in working-note prose (e.g. app_docs/feature-406ea199-anchor-fragment-validator.md:16 `/path#frag` + `#frag`; specs/adw/patch-adw-bc4f2e9d-*:21 `[text](/path)`) mis-parsed as real links -- NOT real docs drift; do not edit those pages to dodge the walker. The repo-local walker (scripts/link-health-report.mjs, which feeds the advisory link-health report + metrics/link-health.jsonl trend) is NOW inline-code aware (issue #423): it blanks fenced blocks and inline `code` spans before link extraction, so these examples are no longer counted. The BLOCKING nightly walker is the SurfaceReport walker in mnemom-test, which this docs repo cannot edit; it still needs the same inline-code-span/fenced-code awareness (and/or an app_docs/feature-* exclusion) -- the cross-repo follow-up tracked in mnemom-test#235 that never landed. scripts/link-health-report.mjs stands as the canonical reference implementation to port. Kept advisory/budget 2 until that mnemom-test-side fix lands and a live run confirms failed==0.
